source_evidence: PLAYER in-character statement, exact: 'If they are doing this to their own people, imagine what they are doing on the contested fronts...' Spoken at Sedgecross wayhouse Day285~08:30 after party's three-day paid recovery, actual full Long Rest completed, eleven patients still stable but three cannot walk and continued medical/refuge placement pending. DM treats it as V's expressed concern, not proof of Veyran frontier crimes and not a decision to depart or publicize evidence. NPC responses independently: Fenar angrily considers the dangerous military application of EVERMARCH pain endurance trials and CLEAR WILL coerced obedience as speculative threat; Cirren soberly warns that documents PROVE Kestrel crimes, not every front, and opposes forgetting rescued patients; Mara suggests original requisition/transfer ledger could provide a finite documentary lead to related military procurement, but does not assert such a connection has been proven, and cautions against giving originals to implicated bureau or unfounded blanket accusations. Discussed evidence already physically read: local original patient folios falsely discharge six of eleven still detained, signed coercive trial/injury records, original Kestrel authorization from western Service Directorate regional bureau bearing Corven Nask name, original EVERMARCH/CLEAR WILL research orders and original transfer/requisition ledger. No new document details, signature, shipment lead or war-front event is uncovered, no omniscient revelation of higher command, other fronts, divine deaths or hidden DM truth. Conversation ~1min during breakfast, no dice required, no NPC travel, no action or resource expense, no outside report or document handoff. All party numbers remain exact: V48/48 HP AC19 HD7/7 Sup4/4 Psi6/6 MP7/7 PastLife3/3 PsiRecovery1/1 ActionSurge1/1 SecondWind1/1 free Psychic Whispers1/1; Fenar59/59 HP HD6/6 Rage4/4 Shift3/3 MP6/6 Bestial Soul CLIMB40; Cirren51/51 HP full spells/CD2, Mara healthy, 4 horses and coach intact; V purse922gp6sp6cp, rations9/feed12, PixieDust1 unopened, LongRest6/6 completed. V maintains original bureau authorization, program orders, transfer ledger, prior false discharge records, signed local trial packet and KN-M1 mage pouch; Mara her Neri notes; Fenar six intact sealed reagents and silver-fitted tool. Eleven patients in wayhouse after previously PAID three nights, no new booking, hospital referral, payment, protection, future date or healing; three still immobile. V's next choice remains who to trust with originals/how to arrange patient long-term care, with possible frontier investigation only a proposal, not accepted movement.
